# Rolezinho

> App for organizing informal get-togethers. Each event lives at
> `/r/<slug>`. Each group lives at `/g/<slug>`. Guests join
> anonymously; creating a rolê or a group requires an account.

## For agents and automation

- [Agent and automation overview](/agents.md): entry point for
  LLMs, WhatsApp bots, dashboards. Lists the three programmatic
  surfaces and when to use each.
- [REST API spec](/api.md): bearer-authenticated JSON API at
  `/api/v1`. Create keys at `/me/chaves`.
- [URL-driven update spec](/atualizar.md): clickable URLs an LLM
  can hand a human to update attendee lists without API access.

## For humans

- [Home](/): public listing of open rolês and groups.
- [Create a rolê](/criar): requires sign-in.
- [Create a group](/g/criar): requires sign-in.
- [Preferences](/me): per-user settings and API-key management.
